integrity.diagnostic_limit: Finite tests corroborate identities, but infinite assertions rest on analytic proof.

scientific_limitations: Only logistic activation and nonnegative row-stochastic time-independent coupling are treated.
A common forcing can be arbitrary measurable; the result controls coordinate diameter, not common-mode behavior or unique equilibrium.
The best coefficient is universal over networks; particular networks need not attain it.
The two unequal-activity fixed points are not claimed globally attracting in the full phase space.
Related results in wider nonlinear consensus literature may limit novelty; independent bibliographic validation has not been performed.
title: Sharp nonlinear synchronization envelope for logistic threshold networks
